title: Accurate PDF error messaging + product field pre-validation and hardening

requirements.summary: Derive PDF-step UI errors from the underlying cause (jsPDF load failure vs invalid/missing product data) instead of a generic prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: When jsPDF is not available (e.g., getJsPDF() throws "jsPDF library not loaded"), the displayed error explicitly indicates jsPDF failed to load and suggests retrying after ensuring the library is available.
When product fields are missing/blank, the displayed error explicitly lists which fields are missing (name, subtitle, description) for the affected product.
The error message shown for PDF failures is derived from the underlying error (GenerationError.originalError) and is not a generic/incorrect prompt.

file_operations.description: Update PDF-step formatting to inspect GenerationError.originalError and emit actionable, accurate messages (e.g., jsPDF CDN not loaded vs. validation/missing fields). Remove the current always-the-same prompt for PDF failures.
Extend structured error handling support for generation to preserve/propagate meaningful causes that the formatter can reliably map to user messages (without changing app flow).

requirements.summary: Pre-validate required product fields (trimmed) before generating single or all PDFs, and block generation with clear guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking “Generate” for a product with missing/blank name, subtitle, or description does not call the PDF generator and instead shows a clear validation error in English.
Clicking “Generate All Products” skips/blocks generation if any product has missing required fields and reports which product(s) need fixes.
Validation uses trimmed strings (e.g., whitespace-only values are treated as missing).

file_operations.description: Add a reusable product required-field validator that treats trimmed whitespace-only strings as missing and returns a structured result suitable for UI messaging.

Add pre-validation checks in "Generate" and "Generate All Products" handlers; block generation when invalid and set the existing workspace error alert to a clear English message listing missing fields per product and/or which products need fixes.
Align editor labels/required-field indicators with the actual required fields (name, subtitle, description) and ensure the Generate button behavior does not bypass workspace-level pre-validation.

requirements.summary: Harden PDF generation against undefined/null/empty text inputs by normalizing to strings and preventing jsPDF text calls with non-string data.
acceptanceCriteria: If any of product.name/product.subtitle/product.description is unexpectedly undefined/null at runtime, PDF generation fails with a clear, accurate error indicating invalid product data (not a generic message), and logs useful diagnostics via existing logging.
No jsPDF doc.text invocation receives a non-string value (verified by code changes and manual testing through the UI).

file_operations.description: Normalize/guard all product text inputs (name/subtitle/description and any other strings passed into jsPDF) so doc.text and splitTextToSize are only called with strings/arrays of strings; on invalid runtime product data, throw a clear invalid-data error and keep existing console diagnostics useful.
Ensure jsPDF availability errors remain distinct and machine-detectable (e.g., consistent error messages) so UI can accurately report jsPDF load failures.
Improve PDF-step error propagation so the underlying PDF/validation/jsPDF cause is preserved for downstream formatting and logging, without changing the overall bundle-generation workflow.
